title: Container Security
brief: **Ticket:** harden a Docker image. Find what unsafe user the insecure image runs as.
theory:
## Container security
Pin base image by digest (not latest), run **non-root**, minimal base, read-only fs, drop capabilities, scan with Trivy. A container running as root is a key finding.
worked_example:
```
FROM ubuntu:latest     # unpinned
# no USER -> runs as root
```

knowledge_check.q: Containers should run as a ___ user
Base images should be pinned by ___ not 'latest'

steps:
```bash
cd /workspaces/examto/container-k8s-lab
python3 -c "from validator.dockerfile_lint import lint;[print(f['rule']) for f in lint(open('manifests/insecure/Dockerfile').read())]"
```
Compare manifests/secure/Dockerfile to see the non-root fix.

capture.task: **Name the unsafe user.** A container should NOT run as which user? (one word)
